mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a framework silicate composed entirely of silicon-oxygen tetrahedra."
Quartz is a framework silicate composed entirely of silicon-oxygen tetrahedra.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of silica tetrahedra which form single chains, whereas the amphiboles are composed of silica tetrahedra double chains."
The pyroxenes are composed of silica tetrahedra which form single chains, whereas the amphiboles are composed of silica tetrahedra double chains.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a naturally occurring, homogeneous solid with a definite (not fixed) chemical composition, and a highly ordered atomic arrangement usually formed by inorganic processes."
A MINERAL is a naturally occurring, homogeneous solid with a definite (not fixed) chemical composition, and a highly ordered atomic arrangement usually formed by inorganic processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to measure solids, liquids, and gases."
Refractive index is used to measure solids, liquids, and gases.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the width of the peak at half of maximum intensity."
Peak width is the width of the peak at half of maximum intensity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an excellent sorbent for a variety of organic and inorganic pollutants."
The soil is an excellent sorbent for a variety of organic and inorganic pollutants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the smallest of the three particles, they adhere together when wet to form a sticky mass and also forms a hard clod when dry."
Clay particles are the smallest of the three particles, they adhere together when wet to form a sticky mass and also forms a hard clod when dry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the general appearance of a mineral surface in reflected light."
Luster is the general appearance of a mineral surface in reflected light.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the colour of the mineral powder."
Streak is the colour of the mineral powder.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of silicon tetrahedral, aluminum octahedral and magnesium hydroxyl or brucite sheet."
Sheet silicates are composed of silicon tetrahedral, aluminum octahedral and magnesium hydroxyl or brucite sheet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the composition of the solid inorganic phases that control the physical and chemical processes in soils."
Soil mineralogy is the study of the composition of the solid inorganic phases that control the physical and chemical processes in soils.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the instrument used to measure refractive index."
A refractometer is the instrument used to measure refractive index.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extremely powerful, and most definitive method for identifying clay minerals."
X-ray diffraction is an extremely powerful, and most definitive method for identifying clay minerals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a result of pedogenic transformation of primary minerals."
Secondary Minerals Secondary minerals are a result of pedogenic transformation of primary minerals.

Physical properties of minerals
Physical properties of minerals are the most abundant mineral properties that describe mineral morphology, microscopic content and economic importance.
______ is a complex mixture of mineral matter, originating from parent material and organic debris under the influence of biogeochemical activities.
soil solid phase
The Solid Phase The soil solid phase is a complex mixture of mineral matter, originating from parent material and organic debris under the influence of biogeochemical activities.
______ is the first step in mineral analysis.
Identifying minerals
Identifying minerals is the first step in mineral analysis.
______ are the most abundant clay minerals in soils worldwide, they are particularly characteristic of highly weathered soils (Ultisols, Oxisols).
Kaolinite group minerals
Kaolinite group minerals are the most abundant clay minerals in soils worldwide, they are particularly characteristic of highly weathered soils (Ultisols, Oxisols).
______ is a thin film which is transparent to electrons.
replica
A replica is a thin film which is transparent to electrons.
______ is the opposite of solid solution.
EXSOLUTION or UNMIXING This process
EXSOLUTION or UNMIXING This process is the opposite of solid solution.
______ are used to estimate the strength and settlement characteristics of soils.
atterberg limits
The atterberg limits are used to estimate the strength and settlement characteristics of soils.
______ are the most common primary sheet silicates, such as muscovite (white mica) and biotite (black mica).
Micas
Micas are the most common primary sheet silicates, such as muscovite (white mica) and biotite (black mica).
______ is a repository for dissolved solids and gases, and for this reason is referred to as the soil solution.
Soil water
Soil water is a repository for dissolved solids and gases, and for this reason is referred to as the soil solution.
______ are the most abundant minerals in the earth's crust; they make up 50 - 60 % of the crustal rocks.
Feldspars
Feldspars are the most abundant minerals in the earth's crust; they make up 50 - 60 % of the crustal rocks.
______ is a magnesium oxide that is electrically neutral.
chemical so produced
The chemical so produced is a magnesium oxide that is electrically neutral.
______ are composed of tetrahedra linked through their corners into a continuous 3D-structure while tetrahedral units of chain silicates are linked by sharing 2 of the 3 basal oxygen.
Framework silicates
Framework silicates are composed of tetrahedra linked through their corners into a continuous 3D-structure while tetrahedral units of chain silicates are linked by sharing 2 of the 3 basal oxygen.
______ is the amount of light transmitted or absorbed by a solid.
Diapheneity
Diapheneity is the amount of light transmitted or absorbed by a solid.
______ are made up of single chain of silica tetrahedral and are easily weatherable, examples are the pyroxenes and amphiboles.
Chain silicates
Chain silicates are made up of single chain of silica tetrahedral and are easily weatherable, examples are the pyroxenes and amphiboles.
